front.title: PSI Receipts for AI Agent Actions

abstract.t:
This document defines a profile of Proof of Stateful Integrity (PSI) for recording actions taken by software agents, including calls to language models and tools. The agent runtime computes a digest of each action locally and seals only the digest, so later alteration or omission of a recorded action is detectable. A receipt shows that a specific action record existed unchanged at a time; it does not show that the action was correct, safe, authorised, or lawful, and it allocates no liability.
This revision withdraws the liability-allocation language of revision 00 and aligns the Merkle commitment with draft-singh-psi-merkle-01.
